transcriber_notes: SnowPro-style Windows form screenshot (1259x856), no branding -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 26/11/2012 agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.7 px/cm (0 cm at y697). All ten table lines have leaders to H-column heights 76/66/52/37/26/22.5/19/7/5/0 (+-0.5 cm). Hardness from bar widths (origin x614; F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px): F, 4F, 4F- (23 px), 1F, 1F+, 4F, 1F+, 1F; the R-column icons agree for every table row. Temperatures on 13.6 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline; dashed air line at -10.7 = printed air temp); the first circle is at 56 cm (no point at the surface); the line ends at ~0 cm without a visible marker, not recorded.
